summary.text: Felicia Brabec is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A clinical psychologist and former Washtenaw County commissioner, she served in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2021 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Brabec was born in Aurora, Illinois.

She earned a bachelor's degree in sociology and anthropology from Saint Mary's College at Notre Dame in 1995, a master's degree in social work from Boston College in 1997, and a Ph.D. in clinical psychology from the Illinois School of Professional Psychology in 2003.
Her career includes working as a clinical psychologist with the University of Michigan Counseling and Psychological Services, as a high school social worker and as a coach.
Brabec has served on the boards of Food Gatherers, Garrett's Space and the Washtenaw Psychology Society, and as of her 2020 campaign had been a Washtenaw County commissioner since 2011.
She won the Michigan House District 55 seat in the November 3, 2020 general election, defeating Bob Baird.
Brabec's House committee assignments were Appropriations in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for the Senate seat on August 4, 2026.
